name: Vállus (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vállus: a blue and white shield with a castle, a deer, a plough and a wheel, with a helm, a crown, a crest and red and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vállus arms with helm, crown, crest and mantling
